board.note: tile x 0..13 left->right, depth 0..9 front->back (Godot: position = Vector3(x, 0, -depth)). Same schema as the Camp's and the Guild's layout.json. The Forge stands against the back wall (slot 0), the Smithy Door at the front edge (slot 5); the centre is empty floor. Every prop faces the camera (face_yaw 0). row: back = button above the prop, front = button below it. Floor and Hall are decor at the board centre, scale 1.
